item.title: MistubaVideo: rendering simulation recordings with Mitsuba
item.description: MistubaVideo turns simulation exports into images and video with Mitsuba 3. Its batch renderer handles OBJ sequences; the mitsuba-video helper replays recorded body poses and surface fields such as wear.
